summary: City Council needs to appoint two public members to serve on the Toronto Public Library Board. The Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Public Library will reconvene and consider candidates on March 5, 2018, and recommend two public members to the Civic Appointments Committee to fill these positions.
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Public Library Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 30, 2018 and until successors are appointed: - Ramin Faraji - Daniel Rotsztain 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (February 9, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board. Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (February 9, 2018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.
